name: Midlands Packaging Corp
old_description: Midlands Packaging primarily produces folding cartons, corrugated containers, and thermoformed plastics. Our goal is to provide you with the service you deserve, and design an innovative and functional carton that meets your standards for quality as well as ours.
about:
Midlands Packaging Corporation has operated from Lincoln, Nebraska since its founding on April 1, 1972. The company remains locally owned and managed, with sales offices across the Midwest in Dallas, Denver, Kansas City, Minneapolis, Omaha, St. Louis, and Sioux City.

The manufacturer produces folding cartons, corrugated containers, thermoformed plastics, laminated cartons, specialty boxes, and point-of-purchase displays. Its facility houses four KBA Rapida 105 presses capable of six-color printing with inline UV coating, four die cutters, four gluers, a sheeter, and an in-house die shop that shortens tooling lead times. Structural design uses CAD linked to CAM, and the 170-person workforce averages 15 years of tenure.

Midlands serves retail and pharmaceutical customers requiring packaging that meets FDA regulations (21 CFR 176.180, 211.122) and Federal Specification PPP-B-566E, as well as food-industry clients covered by its SQF Level 1 certification. The quality system follows ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 sampling, and the plant holds FSC Chain of Custody certification.

The company emphasizes assigned account teams — each customer receives a dedicated sales person and service representative — and highlights its in-house die shop, long-tenured staff, and 100% recycling of production waste as operational differentiators.
